core.title: Large Oiled Bronze Crab Door Knocker, Michael Healy MH1154
tags: Michael Healy blue Crab door knockers

text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1154, 6 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

This Premium Oiled Bronze Blue Crab Door Knocker is made by Michael Healy Designs and shows the craftsmanship and attention to detail that has made their unique door knockers the prized possession of many home owners. This Large Oiled Bronze Crab Door Knocker is 6 inches tall and 7 inches wide, making sure it will stand out even on over-sized doors. This front door knocker has 1-3/8 inch mounting centers and comes packaged with the installation hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass and Brown Patina Nickel Silver

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 7"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-3/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
